note: Upgrade costs, durations, level stats and requirements are sourced from a third-party MIT-licensed community dataset assembled from Clash of Clans Wiki data. They are not a Supercell official API feed. Supercell release notes are used to cross-check major game updates. Catalog entries marked supercharge=true are parsed as a separate upgrade track; Supercharge tiers are not mixed with ordinary levels or normal upgrade totals. Displayed limits should be treated as a dated reference and checked against the in-game upgrade screen after balance updates.
